method_evidence.claim: We introduce X-Part, a controllable and editable diffusion framework for semantically meaningful and structurally coherent part generation.
method_evidence.anchor: we introduce $\mathcal{X}$-Part, a controllable and editable diffusion framework, which enables semantically meaningful and structurally coherent part generation.

method_evidence.claim: X-Part uses bounding boxes as prompts instead of segmentation results to mitigate overfitting.
method_evidence.anchor: we propose a part-level cues extraction module that uses bounding boxes as prompts to indicate part locations and scales, instead of directly using segmentation results as input.

method_evidence.claim: X-Part integrates high-dimension point-wise semantic features with feature perturbation.
method_evidence.anchor: we carefully introduce the semantic features into our framework with delicately designed feature perturbation

experiment_evidence.claim: P3-SAM outperforms baselines on PartObjectarverse-Tiny across fully segmentation without connectivity, with connectivity, and interactive segmentation.
P3-SAM outperforms baselines on watertight PartObjectarverse-Tiny.
X-Part achieves state-of-the-art shape decomposition on ObjaversePart-Tiny.
